newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: First Abacus to get Phileo as investor.
newsitem.headline: First Abacus to get Phileo as investor.

text.p: First Abacus Financial Holdings Corp said on Wednesday it had signed a memorandum of understanding with Phileo Allied Berhad for Phileo to take a 30 percent equity stake in the company.
Terms of the purchase were not disclosed.
In a statement sent to the Philippine Stock Exchange, First Abacus said the companies plan to establish an integrated financial services group in the Philippines.
First Abacus will contribute its strength in the local equities markets while Phileo will bring in its international distribution and electronic banking expertise, the statement said.
Phileo is a financial service provider listed on the main board of the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.

Its wholly-owned financial institution is AlliedBank (Malaysia) Bhd, while its stockbrokering arm, Phileo Allied Securities Sdn Bhd, is a member of the Hong Kong Stock Exchange and the Australia Stock Exchange, the statement said.
